independentReview.peer: Independent peer accepted after viewing all seven supplied complete target, word, numbered unit and paired/detached control frames. The target has a substantial rounded low-left lobe below head recession, adjoining the continuing right tail around a small white window; the plain paired yod lacks that added lobe. Detached36 fixes its position and the same-font paired pointed yod repeats the whole outline. Source19 runs from ויהי כאשר פתחו את־ through ואין עמך רמיה עד־מה before source20. No vowel approval.

decisions.finding: The complete yod narrows below its head and then expands into an additional lower-left lobe beside the continuing right tail. The paired BEL15 pointed yod has this same branch, while the paired plain yod has only the narrow tail. The detached BEL36 dagesh fixes the added lobe position. A small inner white opening corroborates the contour but is neither required nor alone sufficient. Append BC after the existing B4, preserving every prior scalar and combining order.
